diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepeat actions that have already produced the same result, especially clicks, no-ops, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged state forces a strategy change, reducing loops and wasted operations. Cost: state comparison, bookkeeping, and occasional premature switching when repetition is legitimately necessary.
policy_text: Track the observable state and outcome of each action. If the same action on the same target produces no new state twice, do not repeat it unchanged; reassess assumptions and choose a materially different action, target, or strategy. Repeat only with explicit evidence that waiting or retrying can change the outcome.

quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated-result operations total 1,485 on the candidate/bad side versus 224 on the base/good side: 6.63× as many and a net bad excess of 1,261.
result:repeated contributes +1,261 operations, 11.31% of the profile magnitude; major positive action paths are click +639, noop +356, and scroll +277.
